name: Besalú (Spain)
description: Divided vertically into two equal parts, the hoist red with a yellow patriarchal cross and the fly with four red pales on yellow.
history: The council opened the adoption file on 19 April 1995 and the flag was approved on 10 May 1995 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya; it is based on the arms and shows exactly the same in each partition: a yellow patriarchal cross on red at the hoist and four red pales on yellow at the fly.

features.role: four red pales on yellow at the fly
